files.what_breaks_if_deleted: Adopted request vocabulary can drift from runtime validation; UI/SMS consumption remains untested.
Generated parity, per-operation preservation, normative copies and initial token value/type preservation lose their independent assertions.
Primary v2 malformed inputs, Me identity, ConsentScope compatibility, collection bounds and closed-envelope regressions lose independent assertions.

Missing generator CLI, contaminated stdout, source echo, root drift fail-open, skipped Turbo participation and no-op package checks escape independent command-level regressions. Typed package scripts could be omitted from strict lint/typecheck while src still passes. Scratch dependencies must exclude parent pnpm workspace metadata; clean controls assert the actual scratch package/script ran, and unmatched filters fail closed. Canonical temporary paths and package-name filtering prevent Windows short/long-path selection failures; child-process task identity is observed before negatives. Nested root pnpm lifecycle/package labels must not masquerade as child identity; observer still requires actual task executable and canonical package cwd.

limitations: CK-098 is contract structural coverage, not running API replay.
Coverage is limited to the listed executable checks and retained source pins.
HTTP malformed-input rejection and verbose-error sanitization remain not-run; v2 defines no error schema.
UI/SMS reuse, cross-org and server-side role authorization remain unverified.
ADR-006 v2 single primary schema mapping adopted; prior peer-only expectations superseded.
